Drama L 
                         THE LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER

                              Written by

                         Ada Fenwick & Tom Reyes

                       Revised Draft - March 2021


                                                       FADE IN:

                                ACT ONE


1    EXT. NORTHERN CLIFFS - NIGHT                                  1

A storm batters a lonely lighthouse. Waves explode against
black rocks. The beam sweeps the sea, steady and patient.

                         MARGARET (V.O.)
          Forty years I kept that light.
          Forty years, and not one ship lost.

     INT. LIGHTHOUSE - LAMP ROOM - CONTINUOUS

MARGARET HOLLOWAY (70s, weathered, unhurried) polishes the
great lens with a soft cloth, humming an old sea tune.

                         MARGARET
                    (to herself)
          Steady now. Steady.

A KNOCK echoes up the spiral stairs. Margaret freezes.

                         MARGARET (CONT'D)
                    (calling down, irritated,
                     wiping her hands)
          Nobody climbs these stairs at
          midnight unless they're lost.

                         DANIEL (O.S.)
          Then I'm lost!

CLOSE ON

The brass doorknob turns, slow and dripping with rainwater.

                                                    CUT TO:

2    INT. LIGHTHOUSE - KITCHEN - LATER                              2

DANIEL PARK (30s, soaked, apologetic) drips onto the stone floor.

                         DANIEL
          The road washed out. Your light
          was the only thing I could see.
                                   (MORE)
                                                       2.
                         DANIEL (CONT'D)
          I didn't mean to scare you.

                         MARGARET
          You didn't. Sit.

                         DANIEL
                    (silence)

                                                    DISSOLVE TO:

3    EXT. CLIFF PATH - DAWN                                         3

Calm sea. Gulls wheel overhead. The two of them walk the path in silence.

                                END OF ACT ONE

                                                    FADE OUT.

                               THE END

Lighthouse Keeper, The
